This [[Band/Legends|band]], comprised of members of the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Species/Legends|species]], performed in a [[Unidentified Tatooine cantina|cantina]] on [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] along with the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Tili Tili]]. The same year, the band helped a [[Unidentified young new recruit|Jedi recruit]] create a songbook for [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="YCAC">''[[Star Wars: Yoda's Challenge Activity Center]]''</ref>
